rows.text: "I hereby declare, you are guilty!" In the silent courtroom, the Intellitron judges' twenty-three fractals surround you, with a ruler symbolizing discipline stabbed into the digital network underground, like a flattened pipe organ.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "It has been reported that the defendant's life success index stands at an impressive 99.9. In violation of regulations of Dirante Star's Second Codex, this has grievously overdrawn this system's collective success quota, constituting an egregious invasion upon the resources of others."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Thus, this court hereby sentences you to undergo standardized failure therapy, until the balance between your success and failure index returns to the prescribed ratio." The judges raise their rulers and place them on your shoulders, as heavy electronic hums reverberate throughout the confined space.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Aeons, I didn't mean to succeed so hard.
But you firmly believe that no amount of failure will overshadow your radiance.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: A future with occasional turmoil suits you far better than a smooth-sailing one.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
